tools.name: validate_einvoice

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_xrechnung, validate_einvoice · Private data: create_zugferd, create_xrechnung, check_leitweg_id, validate_einvoice · Public sink: create_zugferd, create_xrechnung · Destructive: create_zugferd, create_xrechnung.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_xrechnung, validate_einvoice · Private data: create_zugferd, create_xrechnung, check_leitweg_id, validate_einvoice · Public sink: create_zugferd, create_xrechnung · Destructive: create_zugferd, create_xrechnung

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "create_xrechnung" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
